observations.title: Uptrend mostly intact (6/7 trend-template checks)
observations.detail: Missing: price above the 50-day. Leaders in a Stage 2 uptrend typically meet all seven; stocks failing several are rarely where the strongest moves start.

observations.title: Trading below the 50-day average
observations.detail: Leaders usually hold the 50-day. A close below it, especially on heavy volume, is a common warning sign.
